title: Find First and Last Position
statement:
Given a sorted array of N integers (may have duplicates) and a target T, find:
- The index of the **first** occurrence of T.
- The index of the **last** occurrence of T.

If T is not present, print -1 -1.

Use binary search (O(log N)) — no linear scan.
constraints:
1 <= N <= 10^7
-10^9 <= A[i] <= 10^9
Array is sorted in non-decreasing order.
-10^9 <= T <= 10^9
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers N and T.
Line 2: N space-separated integers in non-decreasing order.
outputFormat: Two integers on a single line: `first last`. Print -1 -1 if T not found.

examples.explanation: 5 first appears at index 4, last at index 5.
